name: SCOWL (Spell Checker Oriented Word Lists)
copyright: Copyright 2000-2018 by Kevin Atkinson and the contributors named in SCOWL-LICENSE.txt.
modifications: Extracted and deduplicated lowercase ASCII words of 4–10 letters from the source files listed below. Source spelling is unchanged.

filters.spellingPolicy: Standard American English: shared English and American source categories only; no optional variant lists.
filters.caseConversion: none; uppercase entries are rejected before any normalization
filters.ordering: deduplicated and sorted by ASCII code point within each length
filters.exclusions: No British, Canadian, or variant files; no proper-names, upper, abbreviations, contractions, or special files. Non-ASCII letters, punctuation, spaces, and digits are excluded.
filters.curation: No additional familiarity, frequency, content, or manual word exclusions.

puzzleWordsAndAcceptedAnswers: American-only puzzle targets use all included SCOWL source levels through 35 in puzzle-words.json. American-only accepted answers use the broader vocabulary through level 70 in words.json.
